report.summary: payments-api returned 5xx for 14 minutes starting 2026-04-21T10:15 UTC

impact.description: All checkout flows degraded; 12k requests returned 503 between 10:15 and 10:29 UTC

report.trigger: Config rollout at 2026-04-21T10:14 UTC reduced DB connection limit below peak demand.
report.rootCause: Upstream database connection pool exhausted after a config push reduced max_connections from 200 to 50 at 2026-04-21T10:14:32 UTC.
contributingFactors: No alert was wired on db_connections_in_use approaching the cap
Config rollout skipped canary because reviewer flagged it as 'tuning only'

metrics: error_rate climbed from 0.01 req/s to 8.2 req/s at 2026-04-21T10:15
logs: 2026-04-21T10:15:33 payments-api ERROR could not acquire connection after 30s
infra: deployment payments-api unchanged across the window (replicas=4)

recommendedActions: Roll back the config change that lowered max_connections
Require canary for any DB-limit config change

report.summary: session-cache hit ratio fell from 99.4% to 71% for 22 minutes on 2026-04-22

impact.description: Session lookups added 80ms p95 latency for the duration; no failed requests

report.trigger: Redis maxmemory hit at 2026-04-22T03:11:44 UTC after a backfill job added 2.4M new keys.
report.rootCause: The nightly profile-backfill job wrote 2.4M new session keys without TTL, pushing Redis past its maxmemory limit at 2026-04-22T03:11:44 UTC and triggering allkeys-lru eviction across hot session entries.
contributingFactors: The backfill job's TTL parameter was set to 0 in last week's PR
No staging test exists for the backfill at production key cardinality

timeline.event: Redis used_memory hit maxmemory; eviction began

metrics: redis_used_memory_bytes climbed from 1.2GB to 4.0GB between 03:00 and 03:11 on 2026-04-22
redis_keyspace_hits / (redis_keyspace_hits + redis_keyspace_misses) dropped from 0.994 to 0.71 at 2026-04-22T03:12

recommendedActions: Patch the profile-backfill job to set TTL on every written key
Add a staging integration test that runs the backfill at production cardinality
Raise Redis maxmemory by 30% as a safety margin during the next deploy window

report.summary: Routine 30-minute investigation triggered by Kafka producer epoch reset; no degradation observed

impact.description: No customer impact; ingestion rate remained within normal variance

report.trigger: Kafka producer epoch reset logged at 2026-04-23T20:06:55Z; classified as routine.
report.rootCause: The Kafka producer client's epoch reset is part of normal exactly-once-semantics rebalancing and does not indicate a fault. Replicas held steady (5/5 ready) and ingestion_rate stayed within ±5% of the prior 7-day median across the window.

metrics: ingestion_rate stayed at 12.4k events/s ±5% from 2026-04-23T20:00 to 2026-04-23T20:30
logs: 2026-04-23T20:06:55 ingestion-server INFO kafka producer epoch reset to 5
infra: ingestion-server pods all Ready; no restarts in the 8h prior

recommendedActions: Suppress proactive scans on bare epoch-reset log entries — they are benign and create noise
